description: This file defines a C# class 'RadixToStringConverter' that implements the IValueConverter interface for converting radix types to their string representations in a UWP application.

classes.name: RadixToStringConverter
classes.description: A value converter class that converts integer radix types to their string labels for display purposes.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts an integer radix value to its corresponding string label (e.g., 'Bin', 'Oct', 'Dec', 'Hex').
